clips.title: The story
paras: In Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers Razorhide to those who bring him blood shards. The captive quilboar trades Agamaggan’s life essence for a blessing that hardens the skin before battle.

The quilboar trace their power to Agamaggan, the Great Boar who died fighting the Burning Legion thousands of years ago. His blood sank into the Barrens and hardened into crystalline shards, still alive with ancient power. The Horde and quilboar remain sworn enemies, yet Mangletooth, held in a cage at Camp Taurajo, will share sacred knowledge for these fragments.

Quilboar are born with thick hides and protective quills, but their warriors call on Agamaggan to harden their skin against blades and claws. Mangletooth can perform the rite for outsiders, channeling four blood shards to strengthen their defenses and help keep their bones unbroken in the wilds.

clips.title: Progress
paras: All those who enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.
Bring me 4 blood shards and I will grant you the same protection.
